resources.string: One-tap shortcut: app drawer, notifications, quick settings and more. You can use any icon.
• These actions need the “Xperia action” accessibility service to be turned on once. It only performs the tap; it never reads your screen.
Turn on “Xperia action” in Accessibility settings
Turn on “Xperia action” under Installed apps in Accessibility settings so this widget can perform its action. It only performs the tap; it never reads your screen.
Lets the Xperia action widget open the app drawer, notifications, quick settings, recent apps and lock the screen. It does not read or store anything on your screen.
Brushed-metal analog clock with a live orange seconds hand.
